**Big: 1082 hits across 94 files.** Only the 75 files under `services/` plus `lib/audit.js` are safe.

| Must not rename | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | public contract, dated version |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | frozen wire keys |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 4 | regenerated by `vendor:refresh` |
| `migrations/` | 12 | already applied history |

Repo files also hold live SQL column names. A new migration must rename the column. Sign off only with that migration attached.
